description: The file defines a class RSSPullParser that reads and parses an RSS feed XML, extracting image URLs and thumbnails, and storing them in a vector of ContentValues objects. It handles XML parsing using Android's XmlPullParser API, and is designed for use within an Android application.

classes.name: RSSPullParser
classes.description: A class to parse RSS feeds and extract image data, specifically media content and thumbnails, from XML using Android's XMLPullParser.

methods.name: getImages
methods.description: Returns the vector containing all extracted image data as ContentValues objects.

methods.name: parseXml
methods.description: Parses an InputStream containing RSS XML data to extract image URLs and thumbnail URLs, storing each as ContentValues in the mImages vector. Also reports progress via a helper notifier.
